# **ABSTRACT**

This internship report outlines the experience and knowledge gained during my six-week internship at Soni Computer Institute, Surat, where I worked in the capacity of Web Development and Digital Marketing Intern. The internship offered a practical environment to apply and expand my technical skills in WordPress development, ecommerce setup, and digital marketing, and provided valuable exposure to real-world business scenarios.

During this internship, I worked on two live client projects: Dreams Astro Numero, an ecommerce website and marketing platform for an astrologer, and VM Graphites Industries LLP, a B2B business website for promoting graphite products. My role involved complete website development using WordPress, Astra theme, Elementor Pro, and WooCommerce for ecommerce functionality, as well as comprehensive digital marketing strategies including SEO, keyword research, backlink building, and performance marketing campaigns on Google Ads and Meta platforms.

The internship provided hands-on experience with hosting, domain configuration, DNS setup, and understanding how servers actually work in production environments. I gained practical exposure to real performance marketing by launching and optimizing Google Search Ads campaigns and Meta Ads (Facebook/Instagram) campaigns with real budgets, tracking conversions, and iterating based on performance data. This collaborative work environment not only strengthened my technical capabilities in WordPress, Elementor, and WooCommerce but also improved my problem-solving, digital marketing strategy, and professional communication skills—all essential for success in the web development and digital marketing industry.

One of the most valuable aspects of this internship was the opportunity to understand how web development and digital marketing work together as complementary disciplines in a real business context. I observed how a well-designed website is meaningless without proper marketing to drive traffic, and how marketing campaigns require solid technical implementation to convert visitors into customers. This exposure helped me appreciate the importance of coordination between design, development, and marketing teams in delivering effective digital solutions.

Overall, the internship at Soni Computer Institute was an enriching experience that bridged the gap between academic learning and industry expectations. It provided a solid foundation in WordPress development, WooCommerce ecommerce setup, and performance marketing, and helped me build confidence in handling real client projects with real business outcomes. The skills and insights gained during this period have equipped me to pursue further opportunities in web development and digital marketing with a stronger, more practical mindset.

# **CHAPTER 1: INTRODUCTION**

## **1.1 Purpose of the Report**

The purpose of this report is to document and reflect on the professional experience gained during my six-week internship at Soni Computer Institute, Surat, where I worked as a Web Development and Digital Marketing Intern. This report serves as a formal record of the tasks performed, skills acquired, and knowledge enhanced throughout the internship. It also aims to demonstrate how academic learning was applied in a real-world environment, contributing to both my personal and professional growth in the field of web development and digital marketing.

The report further highlights the practical implementation of WordPress with Astra theme and Elementor for website design, WooCommerce for ecommerce functionality, the use of tools like Google Analytics, Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, and Yoast SEO, and hands-on experience with real performance marketing campaigns. It is intended to fulfill the academic requirements of the final semester and provide insight into the industry exposure received during the internship period.

## **1.2 Overview of the Internship**

The internship was conducted at Soni Computer Institute, a leading web development and digital marketing service provider based in Surat, Gujarat. The internship commenced on 3rd March 2025 and continued for a duration of six weeks, concluding on 12th April 2025.

As a Web Development and Digital Marketing Intern, my responsibilities included designing and developing two complete websites using WordPress and Elementor Pro, setting up WooCommerce for ecommerce functionality, configuring hosting and domain setups, performing SEO and keyword research, building quality backlinks, and launching and optimizing paid advertising campaigns on Google Ads and Meta platforms. I actively participated in real projects involving creating a complete ecommerce and marketing platform for Dreams Astro Numero and a B2B business website for VM Graphites Industries LLP. The internship provided a valuable opportunity to bridge theoretical concepts with hands-on development and marketing, enhance my problem-solving abilities, and understand professional practices and workflows in the web development and digital marketing industry.

# **CHAPTER 2: COMPANY PROFILE**

**Company Name: **Soni Computer Institute

**Location: **City Light Complex, Parle Point, Surat, Gujarat

**Established: **2010

**Industry: **IT / Web Development / Digital Marketing

**Website: **www.sonicomputerinstitute.com

Key Services: Soni Computer Institute is a growing web development and digital marketing service provider specializing in custom website design, WordPress development, ecommerce solutions, SEO optimization, and performance marketing services for businesses of all sizes. The company focuses on delivering tailored digital solutions that meet specific client requirements across various domains. Their core services include:

- Custom Website Design & Development: Designing and developing professional websites using WordPress, Astra theme, and Elementor to create visually appealing and functionally robust digital presence.

- WordPress & Ecommerce Solutions: Building WordPress websites with WooCommerce integration, product management, payment gateway setup, and shopping cart optimization for online selling.

- Hosting & Domain Management: Providing web hosting services, domain registration, SSL certificates, cPanel management, and server configuration support.

- Search Engine Optimization (SEO): Offering on-page SEO, keyword research, backlink building, technical SEO, and Google Search Console optimization to improve organic visibility.

- Performance Marketing: Managing Google Ads campaigns, Meta Ads (Facebook/Instagram), Google Analytics setup, conversion tracking, and marketing automation for lead generation and sales.

- Digital Marketing Consultation: Providing strategic guidance and technical support to help businesses build and execute effective digital marketing strategies aligned with their goals.

Soni Computer Institute is committed to delivering high-quality, efficient, and scalable solutions with a client-centric approach, ensuring customer satisfaction and long-term business growth through integrated web development and digital marketing strategies.

# **CHAPTER 3: INTERNSHIP OBJECTIVES**

## **Personal Goals**

- Gain hands-on experience in WordPress website development and WooCommerce ecommerce setup.

- Master the use of Astra theme, Elementor Pro, and other WordPress plugins for professional website design.

- Understand how web hosting, domain configuration, DNS setup, and servers actually work in production environments.

- Learn and implement digital marketing strategies including SEO, keyword research, and backlink building.

- Gain practical experience with performance marketing by launching and optimizing Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns.

- Understand industry work culture, professional ethics, and standards in the web development and digital marketing field.

- Work on real-world client projects and improve problem-solving and analytical skills.

- Develop strong communication and teamwork skills through collaboration with senior professionals.

## **Learning Outcomes**

- Developed hands-on proficiency in WordPress dashboard, theme customization, and plugin management.

- Mastered Astra theme configuration including header/footer design, global colors, and typography settings.

- Learned to build responsive, interactive websites using Elementor Pro page builder with custom widgets and effects.

- Gained practical experience with WooCommerce setup, product catalog management, payment gateways, and checkout optimization.

- Understood hosting infrastructure, cPanel management, DNS configuration, SSL setup, and server basics.

- Performed comprehensive keyword research and competitor analysis for SEO planning.

- Implemented on-page and technical SEO best practices using Yoast SEO plugin.

- Conducted backlink research, created business listings, and executed backlink building strategies.

- Set up Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and conversion tracking for data-driven decision making.

- Launched, monitored, and optimized Google Search Ads and Meta Ads campaigns with real budgets.

- Understood the complete digital marketing funnel from awareness to conversion and retention.

- Gained exposure to the complete software development lifecycle as it applies to web projects and marketing campaigns.

# **CHAPTER 4: SCOPE OF WORK**

## **Tasks and Responsibilities**

As a Web Development and Digital Marketing Intern at Soni Computer Institute, I was actively involved in the complete design, development, marketing, and optimization of two client websites. My core responsibilities included:

- Setting up WordPress installations with proper hosting, domain configuration, DNS setup, and server optimization.

- Installing and configuring Astra theme, Elementor Pro, WooCommerce, and other essential plugins.

- Designing responsive website layouts and pages using Elementor Pro page builder with custom styling and animations.

- Setting up and managing WooCommerce for ecommerce functionality including product catalog, checkout, payment gateways, and shipping.

- Performing keyword research, competitor analysis, and SEO planning for both websites.

- Implementing on-page SEO including meta titles, descriptions, heading structure, alt text, and schema markup.

- Setting up Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, and conversion tracking.

- Building quality backlinks through directory submissions, business listings, and outreach.

- Launching and managing Google Search Ads campaigns targeting commercial keywords.

- Creating and optimizing Meta Ads campaigns on Facebook and Instagram with audience targeting and A/B testing.

- Monitoring ad performance, analyzing metrics, and optimizing campaigns for better ROI.

- Collaborating with team members through daily stand-ups, feedback sessions, and code reviews.

## **Technology and Tools Used**

Throughout the internship, I had the opportunity to work with a variety of modern web development and digital marketing tools and technologies, including:

- WordPress – Content Management System for building and managing websites.

- Astra Theme – Lightweight, fast, and responsive WordPress theme with extensive customization options.

- Elementor Pro – Advanced page builder for creating custom, responsive website layouts without coding.

- WooCommerce – WordPress ecommerce plugin for building online stores with product management and payments.

- Razorpay – Indian payment gateway for processing online transactions.

- Google Ads – Platform for launching and managing Search, Display, and Shopping campaigns.

- Meta Ads Manager – Platform for creating and optimizing Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns.

- Google Analytics 4 – Advanced analytics platform for tracking user behavior and conversions.

- Google Search Console – Tool for monitoring site visibility and managing search performance.

- Google Tag Manager – Tag management system for tracking and implementing analytics without coding.

- Yoast SEO – Plugin for on-page SEO optimization and readability checks.

- Ubersuggest – Keyword research and competitor analysis tool.

- Canva – Design tool for creating ad creatives and social media graphics.

- cPanel – Web hosting control panel for managing domains, databases, file uploads, and server settings.

- FTP/SFTP – File transfer protocols for uploading and managing website files on the server.

## **Type of Work**

The nature of the work was entirely web development and digital marketing focused, spanning across multiple specialized areas. The work involved both front-end website design using Elementor Pro, back-end WordPress configuration, ecommerce setup with WooCommerce, technical SEO implementation, and performance marketing campaign management. I worked on projects that combined website development with comprehensive digital marketing strategies, giving me a complete overview of how modern businesses use integrated web and marketing solutions to achieve their objectives.

# **CHAPTER 5: WORK DONE DURING INTERNSHIP**

## **Week 1: Orientation ****&**** Fundamentals**

- Reported at Soni Computer Institute and received orientation on internship structure, code of conduct, and expectations.

- Introduction to WordPress as a CMS, dashboard walkthrough, and understanding of posts, pages, and plugins.

- Studied Astra theme features and advantages, installed and configured on a practice site.

- Introduction to Elementor page builder, built sample pages using widgets and responsive editing.

- Introduction to Digital Marketing fundamentals – SEO, SEM, social media, and performance marketing concepts.

- Requirement gathering for both client projects – Dreams Astro Numero and VM Graphites Industries LLP.

## **Week 2: Hosting, Domain ****&**** WordPress Setup**

- Learned web hosting concepts, cPanel management, FTP, and server basics.

- Configured domains and subdomains, updated nameservers, and set up DNS records.

- Installed WordPress on both hosting accounts and configured database settings.

- Installed Astra theme, Elementor Pro, WooCommerce, Yoast SEO, and other essential plugins.

- Set up SSL certificates for HTTPS encryption on both websites.

- Learned hands-on about how servers work, PHP processing, and MySQL databases.

## **Week 3: Website Development ****&**** Ecommerce Setup**

- Designed and built the VM Graphites business website with company profile, services, and contact pages.

- Configured WooCommerce for Dreams Astro Numero with product categories, product uploads, pricing, and inventory.

- Set up payment gateway (Razorpay) and configured shipping methods and tax settings.

- Designed homepage, shop page, and product page layouts using Elementor Pro.

- Tested complete checkout flow from product browsing to order confirmation.

## **Week 4: SEO ****&**** On-Page Optimization**

- Performed comprehensive keyword research for both projects using Google Keyword Planner and Ubersuggest.

- Conducted competitor analysis and identified target keywords for organic search ranking.

- Implemented on-page SEO including meta titles, descriptions, H1/H2 structure, and alt text for images.

- Set up Google Search Console and submitted XML sitemaps for both websites.

- Optimized image file sizes and implemented caching for improved page speed.

- Configured Yoast SEO plugin and ensured all pages followed SEO best practices.

## **Week 5: Performance Marketing Setup**

- Set up Google Analytics 4 on both websites and configured conversion events.

- Installed and configured Google Tag Manager for centralized tracking.

- Created Google Ads account and launched Search campaigns targeting high-intent keywords.

- Set up Meta Business Manager, installed Meta Pixel, and configured standard events.

- Created Meta Ads campaigns for both brands targeting relevant audiences.

- Wrote ad copy, designed creatives in Canva, and set up audience targeting and A/B tests.

## **Week 6: Optimization, Backlinks ****&**** Testing**

- Analyzed Google Ads and Meta Ads performance – CTR, CPC, ROAS, and cost per acquisition.

- Optimized campaigns by pausing underperforming keywords and scaling winning ad sets.

- Conducted backlink research and created business listings on IndiaMART, Justdial, and Google Business Profile.

- Performed cross-browser testing and fixed responsive design issues on both websites.

- Ran final PageSpeed Insights tests and implemented performance improvements.

- Prepared handover documentation and presented project results to the team.

# **CHAPTER 6: TECHNOLOGIES USED**

During the six-week internship, I worked with a variety of modern web development and digital marketing technologies and platforms. Here is a detailed explanation of each technology used:

## **1. WordPress**

WordPress is the world's most popular Content Management System (CMS). I used WordPress for building both client websites, managing content, installing plugins, configuring settings, and maintaining the sites. WordPress's flexibility and ease of use made it ideal for rapidly deploying professional websites that could be easily maintained and updated by clients after the internship.

## **2. Astra Theme**

Astra is a lightweight and fast WordPress theme suitable for all types of websites. I used Astra as the base theme for both websites because it offers extensive customization options, comes with multiple starter templates, supports responsive design, and loads quickly. The theme's global color and typography settings made it easy to maintain visual consistency across all pages.

## **3. Elementor Pro**

Elementor Pro is an advanced page builder that allows creating professional layouts without writing code. I used Elementor Pro extensively to design responsive website pages, create custom sections with animations, build landing pages for the seminar, design product pages, and implement interactive elements. Elementor's drag-and-drop interface and responsive editing modes made it easy to design once and have it work perfectly on desktop, tablet, and mobile.

## **4. WooCommerce**

WooCommerce is the leading ecommerce plugin for WordPress. I used WooCommerce to set up the complete ecommerce functionality for Dreams Astro Numero including product catalog management, product variations, shopping cart, checkout process, inventory tracking, and order management. WooCommerce's integration with WordPress and extensive plugin ecosystem made it the ideal choice for the astrology ecommerce store.

## **5. Google Ads**

Google Ads is Google's advertising platform for launching paid search campaigns. I created Search campaigns targeting high-intent keywords like 'online astrologer', 'gemstone for career', and 'graphite electrode supplier'. I wrote responsive search ads, managed bid strategies, monitored performance metrics like click-through rate and cost per click, and continuously optimized campaigns for better ROI.

## **6. Meta Ads Manager**

Meta Ads Manager is the platform for managing Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns. I used Meta Ads to create awareness and lead generation campaigns for both brands, targeting specific audiences based on interests and behaviors. I created ad creatives in Canva, wrote compelling copy, set up audience segmentation, and ran A/B tests to identify the best performing ads.

## **7. Google Analytics 4 ****&**** Google Tag Manager**

Google Analytics 4 is the latest version of Google's web analytics platform providing detailed insights into user behavior. I set up GA4 on both websites, configured conversion events like form submissions and purchases, and used the data to understand user journeys and identify optimization opportunities. Google Tag Manager served as the centralized tag management system, allowing me to implement tracking codes without modifying the website code.

## **8. Yoast SEO**

Yoast SEO is a comprehensive WordPress plugin for on-page SEO optimization. I used Yoast to optimize meta titles, meta descriptions, slug structure, internal linking, readability, and keyword optimization for all important pages on both websites. The plugin provided real-time feedback on SEO quality, helping me ensure each page was fully optimized for search engines.

## **9. Keyword Research ****&**** Analysis Tools**

I used Google Keyword Planner for finding high-volume keywords and estimating search demand. Ubersuggest was used for deeper keyword research, competitor analysis, and identifying backlink opportunities. These tools helped me understand what keywords potential customers were using to search for the services offered by both clients.

## **10. Hosting ****&**** cPanel**

I worked with web hosting providers and cPanel control panel for managing domains, databases, email accounts, file uploads, and server settings. Understanding cPanel, FTP access, database management, and server basics gave me practical knowledge of how websites are deployed and maintained on production servers.

## **11. Additional Tools**

- Razorpay – Indian payment gateway for processing ecommerce transactions.

- Canva – Design tool for creating ad creatives, banners, and social media graphics.

- Google Search Console – Tool for monitoring site visibility, keyword rankings, and technical issues.

- WPForms – Form builder plugin for contact forms and lead capture.

# **CHAPTER 7: CHALLENGES FACED ****&**** SOLUTIONS**

## **Technical Challenges**

One of the most frequent technical challenges I encountered was website performance optimization. Both websites needed to load quickly for good user experience and SEO ranking. I addressed this by implementing image compression, enabling caching, lazy loading, and minifying CSS/JavaScript. Understanding server-side performance optimization was new to me, but by learning from mentors and referring to best practices, I managed to improve page load times significantly.

Another challenge was setting up WooCommerce ecommerce functionality correctly with proper payment gateway integration, shipping configuration, and tax calculations. I solved this by carefully following documentation, testing the checkout flow multiple times, and working with the Razorpay support team when needed.

Understanding how Google Ads bidding strategies work and optimizing for cost per conversion was challenging initially. I overcame this by studying Google's documentation, analyzing performance data regularly, and making data-driven adjustments to bid strategies and keyword targeting.

## **Digital Marketing Challenges**

Creating effective ad copy and designing compelling ad creatives that resonate with the target audience required understanding customer psychology and brand positioning. I addressed this by researching competitor ads, studying the target audience, and iterating designs based on performance data from A/B testing.

Setting up proper analytics tracking and understanding which marketing channels were driving conversions required careful configuration of Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and Meta Pixel. I solved this by creating a detailed tracking plan, working with team members to verify data accuracy, and learning to interpret the analytics insights.

## **Learning Curve ****&**** Teamwork**

Learning WordPress advanced features, Elementor Pro capabilities, and digital marketing tools on the job was a steep learning curve. I managed this by following official documentation, completing online tutorials, seeking guidance from senior team members, and practicing extensively. Through regular interaction with team members, I developed stronger communication skills and learned how to collaborate efficiently in a professional environment.

# **CHAPTER 8: SKILLS GAINED**

During my six-week internship at Soni Computer Institute, I gained extensive practical experience in web development and digital marketing. The internship provided the opportunity to work on real-world projects, apply academic knowledge to industry practices, and strengthen both technical and professional competencies. Below are the key skills I developed:

## **Web Development Skills**

- WordPress Website Development – Installed, configured, and customized WordPress websites from scratch with proper structure and optimization.

- Astra Theme Mastery – Configured global colors, typography, header/footer layouts, and other theme settings to match client branding.

- Elementor Pro Page Building – Designed responsive, interactive website pages using Elementor's advanced widgets and design features.

- WooCommerce Ecommerce Setup – Set up complete ecommerce functionality including product management, shopping cart, checkout, payments, and shipping.

- Website Performance Optimization – Implemented caching, image compression, lazy loading, and other techniques to improve page speed.

## **Digital Marketing Skills**

- Keyword Research & Analysis – Conducted comprehensive keyword research using various tools and identified high-intent keywords for targeting.

- On-Page SEO Implementation – Optimized website pages with proper meta tags, heading structure, content, and schema markup.

- Backlink Building – Created business listings, submitted to directories, and identified link building opportunities.

- Google Ads Campaign Management – Created and optimized Search campaigns, managed budgets, monitored performance, and improved ROI.

- Meta Ads Management – Created and optimized Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns with audience targeting and A/B testing.

- Analytics & Tracking – Set up Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and Meta Pixel for comprehensive conversion tracking.

## **Technical Infrastructure**

- Hosting & Domain Management – Configured domains, updated nameservers, set up DNS records, and managed hosting accounts.

- Server Basics – Learned how web servers work, understood PHP processing, MySQL databases, and file permissions.

- SSL & Security – Installed SSL certificates and implemented basic security measures for website protection.

## **Soft Skills**

- Communication – Clear explanation of technical concepts, active listening, and effective feedback at team meetings.

- Time Management – Prioritized tasks, managed multiple projects in parallel, and met internship deadlines consistently.

- Problem-Solving – Analyzed challenges systematically and developed creative solutions using available tools and resources.

- Teamwork – Collaborated effectively with senior developers and marketers, contributed to team discussions, and supported collective goals.

# **CHAPTER 9: LEARNING OUTCOMES**

- Gained real-world experience in complete website development lifecycle from planning through deployment.

- Improved understanding of how web development and digital marketing work together as complementary disciplines.

- Learned practical e-commerce implementation including payment processing, inventory, and customer management.

- Improved problem-solving and debugging skills by troubleshooting real issues in production environments.

- Understood the importance of data-driven decision making through analytics and performance metrics.

- Learned to work with client requirements, deadlines, and feedback in a professional consultancy environment.

- Enhanced communication skills by presenting work, explaining technical concepts, and documenting processes.

- Gained exposure to professional tools, platforms, and best practices used in the web development and digital marketing industry.

- Developed confidence in handling complete projects from requirements gathering through final delivery.

- Understood how server infrastructure, hosting, and domain systems work in real-world scenarios.

- Learned the practical aspects of SEO beyond theoretical knowledge – actual keyword research, implementation, and monitoring.

- Gained hands-on experience with performance marketing including campaign setup, optimization, and ROI analysis.

# **CHAPTER 10: CONCLUSION**

## **Reflection on Internship**

The internship at Soni Computer Institute was a highly enriching and rewarding experience that significantly contributed to my growth as a web developer and digital marketer. Working in a real-world web development and digital marketing environment allowed me to apply my academic knowledge to live projects and enhance my understanding of both website development and marketing. I gained practical exposure to tools like WordPress, Elementor, WooCommerce, Google Ads, Meta Ads, and analytics platforms, and learned to implement complete website and marketing solutions from scratch. The experience helped me build a strong foundation in web development and digital marketing while also preparing me for the professional challenges of the industry.

## **Impact on Career Goals**

This internship experience has aligned perfectly with my career aspirations in the field of web development and digital marketing. It confirmed my interest in pursuing a professional path in WordPress development and digital marketing strategy. The opportunity to work on real client projects, see actual business results from marketing campaigns, and understand how digital solutions drive business growth gave me confidence in this career direction. The experience exposed me to the complete digital ecosystem – how websites, marketing, analytics, and customer experience all interconnect. This internship has equipped me with the practical skills, industry knowledge, and professional mindset needed to pursue further opportunities in web development and digital marketing with clarity and confidence.

## **Personal Growth**

Beyond technical knowledge, the internship fostered significant personal and professional growth. I developed strong communication skills through team interactions and client presentations, improved my time management by working with deadlines across parallel projects, and learned to adapt quickly to new tools and technologies. I also gained a deeper appreciation for attention to detail, proper documentation, and the importance of understanding user experience in both website design and marketing. This experience has not only made me a more skilled developer and marketer but also a more confident, goal-oriented, and professional individual equipped to take on greater challenges.

In summary, the internship at Soni Computer Institute was a valuable milestone in my journey toward becoming a competent and confident web developer and digital marketer. It equipped me with the practical skills, technical knowledge, and professional experience needed to move forward in the field of computer engineering and web development. I am grateful for the opportunity and look forward to applying these learnings in my future career.
